title: dacryodes nervosa
intro: Dacryodes nervosa, commonly known as the Canarium paniculatum or Black Dammar, is a plant species native to the tropical forests of Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its oil, which has been traditionally used in medicine and as a spice. The health benefits of Dacryodes nervosa include its antimicrobial, antifungal, and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against infections and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpenes and terpenoids, and can be used to treat respiratory issues and skin conditions.
